# Setup

```{r}
source("setup.R")
```

Read in park system

```{r}
parks <- getParkSystem()
# read in pre-saved park file
# parks <- st_read("data/rapid/inputs/park_boundaries_2025-08-14.gpkg")

park_centroids <- parks %>% 
  st_centroid() %>% 
  st_transform(4326) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(y = st_coordinates(.)[,2], x = st_coordinates(.)[,1])
```

Read in water supply database for filtered parks

```{r}
table_path <- "data/Water_Supply_Systems/NPS_Water_Systems_Database_Joined.xlsx"


water_supplies <- read_excel(table_path,
                             sheet = 1,
                             na = c("NA", "U"),
                             skip = 1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_longitude = as.numeric(source_longitude),
    source_latitude = as.numeric(source_latitude)
  ) %>%
  filter(!state %in% c("AK", "AS", "HI", "MP", "PR", "VI")) %>%
  left_join(
    park_centroids %>% 
      st_drop_geometry() %>% 
      dplyr::select(UNIT_CODE, x, y),
    by = c(park_unit = "UNIT_CODE")
  ) %>% dplyr::mutate(
    coords_flag = ifelse(
      is.na(source_longitude) |
        is.na(source_latitude),
      "Centroid",
      "Source Coordinates"
    ),
    source_longitude = ifelse(is.na(source_longitude), x, source_longitude),
    source_latitude = ifelse(is.na(source_latitude), y, source_latitude)
  ) %>%
  # remove municipal and hauled source types, accounting for database entry errors
  filter(!str_detect(source_type, regex("municipal|hauled", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  drop_na(source_longitude, source_latitude) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = (c("source_longitude", "source_latitude")),
           crs = 4326,
           remove = FALSE)


```

Save water supplies to app data

```{r}
#write_csv(water_supplies, "rapid_app/app_data/water_supplies.csv")
```

*For each water supply point, calculate indicator at point + \~5km buffer.*

## Create water supply buffer for raster stats

To create appropriate buffers (i.e., smooth instead of jagged), need to apply st_buffer to sf object in a UTM CRS (instead of lat/long)

```{r}
water_supplies_buffer <- water_supplies %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 32616) %>% 
  st_buffer(dist = 4000)
```

# Calculate Indicators

Each indicator should have its own calculation function in a standalone .R file. Below is a standardized template for indicator functions:

```{r eval = FALSE}
calc_[indicator]_[type] <- function( 
    water_supplies,           # sf object with water supply locations
    [indicator_data],         # specific data for this indicator
    additional_data = NULL,   # optional additional datasets
    save = FALSE,            # whether to save output
    output_dir = NULL,       # directory for saving
    verbose = TRUE           # progress messages
) {
  # Function body
} 
```

# Exposure

## Fire

Increase in likelihood of fires

```{r}
# read in files
pyromes <- st_read("data/rapid/inputs/pyromes.gpkg")

pyromes_selected <- read_csv("data/rapid/inputs/pyromes_selected.csv")

# Calculate indicator
fire_exp <- calc_fire_exposure(
  water_supplies = st_filter(water_supplies, pyromes),
  fire_prob_data = pyromes_selected,
  pyrome_data = pyromes,
  save = TRUE,
  output_dir = "data/rapid/outputs/"
)

# BENCHMARK 
## 38.45 secs for 23 parks
## 50.46 MINs for 641 parks
## 1.2 hours for 1184 parks
# NEW TERRA METHOD
## 38.6 seconds for 1151 parks
```

## Water Balance Model Factors

### Runoff

```{r}
runoff_exp <- calc_runoff_exposure(water_supplies = water_supplies,
                                   runoff_data = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_runoff_water_supplies/",
                                   hindcast = TRUE,
                                   historical = c(1995, 2024),
                                   future = c(2035, 2065),
                                   water_year = TRUE,
                                   save = TRUE,
                                   output_dir = "data/rapid/outputs/",
                                   verbose = TRUE)

# 7 minutes for 1412 water sources when hindcast = TRUE
# 4 minutes for 1412 water sources when hindcast = FALSE
```

### Precipitation

```{r}
precip_exp <- calc_precip_exposure(water_supplies = water_supplies,
                                   precip_data = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_precipitation_water_supplies/",
                                   hindcast = TRUE,
                                   historical = c(1995, 2024),
                                   future = c(2035, 2065),
                                   water_year = TRUE,
                                   save = TRUE,
                                   output_dir = "data/rapid/outputs/",
                                   verbose = TRUE)

# 7 minutes for 1412 water sources when hindcast = TRUE
# 19 minutes for 1412 water sources when hindcast = FALSE (observed data is daily!)
```

### Snow Water Equivalent (SWE)

```{r}
swe_exp <- calc_swe_exposure(water_supplies = water_supplies,
                             swe_data = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_swe_water_supplies/",
                             hindcast = TRUE,
                             historical = c(1995, 2024),
                             future = c(2035, 2065),
                             water_year = TRUE,
                             save = TRUE,
                             output_dir = "data/rapid/outputs/",
                             verbose = TRUE)

# 9.5 minutes for 1148 water sources when hindcast = TRUE
```

## Sea Level Rise Inundation

```{r}
# Read buffered water supply scenarios, filter to 4 km and valid inundation files
ws_slr_scenarios <- sf::st_read(here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "coast_comp",
                                     "buff_ws_inun_regions.gpkg")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(proj_file), buffer_km == 4)

# Right-join all water supplies onto ws_slr_scenarios:
ws_all <- ws_slr_scenarios %>%
  select(-park_unit) %>%
  right_join(
    water_supplies %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(wsd_source_id, park_unit),
    by = "wsd_source_id"
  )

slr_inundation_exp <- calc_inundation_exposure(
  ws_scenarios               = ws_all,
  inundation_raster_data_dir = here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "coast_comp",
                                    "Extent_Rasters"),
  save       = TRUE,
  output_dir = here("data", "rapid", "outputs"),
  verbose    = TRUE
)

# 5 minutes for all water sources
```

# Sensitivity

## Fire

Wildfire hazard potential

```{r}
# Calculate indicator
fire_sen <- calc_fire_sensitivity(water_supplies = water_supplies_buffer,
                                  whp_raster = "data/all/usfs_fire/whp2023_GeoTIF/whp2023_cls_conus.tif",
                                  whp_type = "cat",
                                  save = TRUE,
                                  output_dir = "data/rapid/outputs/"
)

# BENCHMARKING (continuous method)
## 1.91 mins for 23 parks
## 54.1 mins for 677 parks
# New categorical method:
# 2.77 mins for 1140 parks
```

## Coastal Inundation

Distance from water supply to nearest NOAA CUSP shoreline feature

```{r}
coastal_sen <- calc_inundation_sensitivity(
  water_supplies = water_supplies,
  cusp_gpkg_path = here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "coast_comp", "cusp_shorelines.gpkg"),
  save = TRUE,
  output_dir = here("data", "rapid", "outputs"),
  verbose = TRUE
)
# 2 Hours for 1412 parks
```

## Flood

Current Flood Risk based on FEMA flood zoning

```{r}
flood_sen <- calc_flood_risk(
  water_supplies,
  dist = 4000,
  save = TRUE,
  output_dir = "data/rapid/outputs/"
)
# took 2.83 hours for 1411 water supplies
```

## Water Balance Model Factors

### Runoff

Historical LOCA runoff data goes up to 2010:

```{r}
runoff_sen <- calc_runoff_sensitivity(water_supplies,
                                      runoff_data = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_runoff_water_supplies/",
                                      historical = c(1980, 2010), 
                                      water_year = TRUE,
                                      save = TRUE,
                                      output_dir = "data/rapid/outputs/",
                                      verbose = TRUE) %>%
  # additional metadata, don't necessarily need but interesting to review as we finalize indicator
  select(-c(n_years, trend_direction, mk_significant))
```

### Precipitation

Historical LOCA precip data goes up to 2018:

```{r}
precip_sen <- calc_precip_sensitivity(water_supplies,
                                      precip_data = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_precipitation_water_supplies/",
                                      historical = c(1980, 2018),
                                      water_year = TRUE,
                                      save = TRUE,
                                      output_dir = "data/rapid/outputs/",
                                      verbose = TRUE) %>%
  # additional metadata, don't necessarily need but interesting to review as we finalize indicator
  select(-c(n_years, trend_direction, mk_significant))
```

### Snow Water Equivalent (SWE)

Historical LOCA SWE data goes up to 2010:

```{r}
swe_sen <- calc_swe_sensitivity(water_supplies,
                                swe_data = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_swe_water_supplies/",
                                historical = c(1980, 2010),
```

## Water Withdrawal Competition

Data currently from USFS compilation of all USGS data use data by county:

```{r}
nearby_use_sen <- calc_nearby_use_sensitivity(water_supplies,
                                              observed_use = fread("data/all/RPAWaterDemand/1_BaseData/Trash 2022/usgswithdrawals.csv"),
                                              save = TRUE,
                                              output_dir = "data/rapid/outputs/",
                                              verbose = TRUE) %>%
  # additional metadata exists, don't necessarily need but some are interesting to review as we finalize indicator
  select(wsd_source_id, park_unit,
         raw_avg_nearby_use_per_km2, raw_percent_slope_nearby_use_per_km2, 
         rank_avg_nearby_use_per_km2, rank_percent_slope_nearby_use_per_km2, 
         norm_avg_nearby_use_per_km2, norm_percent_slope_nearby_use_per_km2)

```

## Visitation

```{r}
visitation_sen <- calc_visitation_sensitivity(water_supplies,
                                              start_year = 1990,
                                              end_year = 2024,
                                              save = TRUE,
                                              output_dir = "data/rapid/outputs/",
                                              verbose = TRUE) %>%
  # additional metadata exists, don't necessarily need but some are interesting to review as we finalize indicator
  select(wsd_source_id, park_unit,
         raw_avg_visitation, raw_scaled_trend_visitation,
         rank_avg_visitation, rank_scaled_trend_visitation,
         norm_avg_visitation, norm_scaled_trend_visitation)
```

# Testing

Filter to Utah parks for testing

```{r}
# park boundaries and metadata
parks_sub <- st_read("data/rapid/inputs/park_boundaries_2025-08-14.gpkg") %>% filter(STATE == "UT")


# park water supplies
table_path <- "data/Water_Supply_Systems/NPS_Water_Systems_Database_Joined.xlsx"


water_supplies_sub <- read_excel(table_path,
                                 sheet = 1,
                                 na = c("NA", "U"),
                                 skip = 1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_longitude = as.numeric(source_longitude),
    source_latitude = as.numeric(source_latitude)
  ) %>%
  filter(park_unit %in% parks_sub$UNIT_CODE) %>%
  filter(!source_type %in% c("Municipal", "Hauled", "municipal", "hauled")) %>%
  drop_na(source_longitude, source_latitude) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = (c("source_longitude", "source_latitude")),
           crs = 4326,
           remove = FALSE)

water_supplies_sub_buffer <- water_supplies_sub %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 32616) %>% 
  st_buffer(dist = 5000)
```

### Fire Exposure

Run indicator:

```{r}
# read in files
pyromes <- st_read("data/rapid/inputs/pyromes.gpkg")

pyromes_selected <- read_csv("data/rapid/inputs/pyromes_selected.csv")

# Calculate indicator
fire_exp <- calc_fire_exposure(
  water_supplies = st_filter(water_supplies_sub, pyromes),
  fire_prob_data = pyromes_selected,
  pyrome_data = pyromes,
  save = FALSE
)

# using terra filter method went form 1.2 minutes to 3 seconds
```

```{r}
)
```
